text:
1. 16. 2. 7. 

Nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekadhammampi samanupassāmi, yenevaṃ sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjanti, yathayidaṃ bhikkhave micchādiṭṭhi. Micchādiṭṭhiyā bhikkhave samannāgatā sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjanti.130
